Class LessonsLearnedList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList
public class LessonsLearnedList extends Object

Title: LessonsLearnedList Class

Description: Holds a collection of LessonsLearned objects and provides the persistent Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations for that collection, together with the operations that produce a subset of it. One instance, produced by readAll(LessonsLearnedDatabase), is the list of every lesson in the system. Every other instance is a subset, such as the lessons that contain a search term or the lessons a particular contributor wrote.

A subset is returned as a new LessonsLearnedList rather than as a bare java.util.List. Returning the same type means the caller can keep narrowing a result, count it, or hand it to the same display code that handles the full set, without caring whether it holds everything or the result of a search. A subset can be empty, can hold one element, or can hold every element, and there is no fixed upper limit on the number of elements, which the growable ArrayList underneath provides.

How the class supports each Contributor user story (see "Requirements to Tests Map.pdf" in the TP2 folder for CS-1 to CS-12):

  • CS-1 Create: createLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase, LessonsLearned) stores the lesson and adds it to this list
  • CS-2 See all lessons: readAll(LessonsLearnedDatabase), newest first, and toDisplayLines()
  • CS-3 Open a lesson: findById(int)
  • CS-4 Search: searchByText(String)
  • CS-5 Filter by category: filterByCategory(String) and getCategories()
  • CS-6 My lessons: filterByContributor(String)
  • CS-7 Update: updateLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase, LessonsLearned) stores the change and replaces the list entry
  • CS-8 Delete: deleteLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase, int) removes the row and the list entry
  • CS-12 Persistence: the three persistent operations all go through the database

The persistent operations keep this in memory list and the database in step, so the screen showing the list does not have to read every lesson again after each change. The subset operations do no database work at all, which is what lets the testing automation check every search and filter without a database.

  • Field Details

    • lessons

      private final List<LessonsLearned> lessons
      Source: the HW2 requirement that a list hold all lessons or any subset, with no fixed upper limit. An ArrayList is used because the number of lessons is not known in advance. It is final so the list object itself is never swapped out from under a caller.

    • readAll

      public static LessonsLearnedList readAll(LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      Method: static LessonsLearnedList readAll(LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      Description: Reads every stored lesson, newest first (CS-2). This is the persistent list of all lessons in the system that the Lessons Learned page starts from.

      Parameters:
      db - the open lessons database
      Returns:
      a list holding every stored lesson, possibly empty

    • createLesson

      public LessonInputPolicy.Problem createLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase db, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: Problem createLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase db, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: Stores a new lesson and, only if that worked, adds it to the front of this list so the list stays newest first (CS-1). Validation happens inside LessonsLearned.create, so a refused lesson is neither stored nor added.

      Parameters:
      db - the open lessons database
      lesson - the new lesson
      Returns:
      null when the lesson was stored, otherwise the problem that stopped it

    • updateLesson

      public LessonInputPolicy.Problem updateLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase db, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: Problem updateLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase db, LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: Stores the changed lesson and, only if that worked, replaces the entry with the same identifier in this list (CS-7). If this list is a subset that does not hold the lesson, the database is still updated and the list is left as it was.

      Parameters:
      db - the open lessons database
      lesson - the lesson holding the identifier and the new values
      Returns:
      null when the lesson was updated, otherwise the problem that stopped it

    • searchByText

      public LessonsLearnedList searchByText(String term)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList searchByText(String term)

      Description: Returns the subset of lessons whose title, description, or keywords contain the term, ignoring case (CS-4). The matching itself is LessonsLearned.matches, so the rule for what counts as a match is written once. An empty term returns an empty subset, because the user asked to narrow the list and should not have it widened.

      Parameters:
      term - the text to look for
      Returns:
      a new list holding only the matching lessons, possibly empty

    • filterByCategory

      public LessonsLearnedList filterByCategory(String category)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList filterByCategory(String category)

      Description: Returns the subset of lessons in the given category, matched exactly but without regard to case (CS-5). A null or empty category returns an empty subset.

      Parameters:
      category - the category to match
      Returns:
      a new list holding only the lessons in that category, possibly empty

    • filterByContributor

      public LessonsLearnedList filterByContributor(String userName)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList filterByContributor(String userName)
